title: REST vs GraphQL vs SOAP
focus: Bandingkan resource-oriented REST, query-driven GraphQL, dan contract-heavy SOAP. Pahami bentuk request, response, schema, caching, serta error handling.
exercise: Rancang endpoint pencarian film yang sama dalam REST, GraphQL, dan SOAP. Tulis kapan masing-masing pilihan masuk akal.

title: HTTP methods and idempotency
focus: Pahami GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, safe methods, dan dampak retry terhadap idempotency.
exercise: Desain API pembayaran yang aman ketika client mengirim request dua kali.

title: HTTP status codes that matter
exercise: Buat tabel status code untuk flow registrasi akun.

title: Headers, cookies, and tokens
focus: Pelajari fungsi Content-Type, Accept, Authorization, Cache-Control, Cookie, dan Set-Cookie.
exercise: Inspect satu request browser dan jelaskan lima header terpentingnya.

title: API pagination patterns
focus: Bandingkan offset, page-number, dan cursor pagination dari sisi konsistensi serta performa.
exercise: Desain pagination untuk feed yang terus menerima data baru.

title: API versioning
focus: Bandingkan versioning lewat URL, header, media type, dan evolusi schema tanpa versi baru.
exercise: Rancang migrasi endpoint v1 ke v2 tanpa memutus mobile client lama.

title: Rate limiting
focus: Pahami token bucket, leaky bucket, fixed window, sliding window, dan header limit.
exercise: Tentukan aturan rate limit untuk login dan public search API.

title: Webhooks vs polling
focus: Bandingkan latency, reliability, retry, signature verification, dan operational cost.
exercise: Desain penerimaan webhook pembayaran dengan retry dan deduplication.

title: SSE vs WebSocket vs long polling
focus: Pahami komunikasi satu arah dan dua arah serta kapan koneksi persisten layak digunakan.
exercise: Pilih teknologi untuk notifikasi, chat, dan live score. Jelaskan alasannya.

title: OpenAPI and contract-first design
focus: Pahami schema, validation, generated clients, documentation, dan contract testing.
exercise: Tulis mini OpenAPI spec untuk endpoint GET /movies/{id}.

title: DNS from browser to server
focus: Ikuti proses resolver, recursive lookup, authoritative server, TTL, dan caching.
exercise: Gunakan nslookup atau dig pada satu domain lalu jelaskan hasilnya.

title: TCP vs UDP
focus: Bandingkan connection setup, ordering, reliability, congestion control, dan overhead.
exercise: Pilih TCP atau UDP untuk file transfer, video call, DNS, dan game multiplayer.

title: The TCP handshake and teardown
focus: Pahami SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK, sequence number, FIN, serta TIME_WAIT.
exercise: Gambar urutan koneksi TCP dan jelaskan fungsi TIME_WAIT.

title: TLS and HTTPS
focus: Pahami certificate, trust chain, key exchange, symmetric encryption, dan integrity.
exercise: Buka detail sertifikat sebuah situs lalu identifikasi issuer dan masa berlaku.

title: Ports, sockets, and connections
focus: Bedakan port, listening socket, connected socket, IP tuple, dan ephemeral port.
exercise: Jelaskan bagaimana ribuan client dapat terhubung ke port 443 yang sama.

title: NAT, private IP, and public IP
focus: Pahami alamat private, address translation, port mapping, dan keterbatasan inbound traffic.
exercise: Petakan perjalanan request dari laptop rumah menuju public web server.

title: Reverse proxy vs load balancer
focus: Bedakan routing, TLS termination, caching, health checks, dan traffic distribution.
exercise: Rancang posisi Nginx dan load balancer untuk tiga instance backend.

title: CDN fundamentals
focus: Pahami edge caching, origin, cache key, invalidation, dan geographic latency.
exercise: Tentukan aset mana yang aman di-cache untuk aplikasi e-commerce.

title: SQL vs NoSQL
focus: Bandingkan relational model, document, key-value, wide-column, graph, serta trade-off query.
exercise: Pilih database untuk transaksi bank, session store, katalog produk, dan social graph.

title: Primary keys and indexes
focus: Pahami B-tree, lookup cost, clustered vs secondary index, dan write overhead.
exercise: Buat indeks untuk query pesanan berdasarkan customer dan tanggal.

title: Composite indexes
focus: Pelajari leftmost prefix, selectivity, covering index, dan urutan kolom.
exercise: Evaluasi indeks (status, created_at) untuk tiga query yang berbeda.

title: Database normalization
focus: Pahami 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, redundancy, update anomaly, dan alasan denormalization.
exercise: Normalisasi tabel order yang mencampur data customer dan produk.

title: ACID transactions
focus: Pahami atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability, commit, dan rollback.
exercise: Rancang transaksi transfer saldo antar dua rekening.

title: Isolation levels
focus: Bandingkan read uncommitted, read committed, repeatable read, serializable, dan anomaly.
exercise: Berikan contoh dirty read, non-repeatable read, dan phantom read.

title: Optimistic vs pessimistic locking
focus: Pahami version column, row locks, contention, deadlock, dan retry.
exercise: Pilih locking untuk pemesanan kursi bioskop yang ramai.

title: N+1 query problem
focus: Kenali pola query berulang dari ORM, eager loading, join, dan batching.
exercise: Temukan dan perbaiki N+1 pada daftar order beserta customer.

title: Replication and failover
focus: Pahami primary-replica, replication lag, read scaling, promotion, dan consistency.
exercise: Desain read/write routing untuk database dengan dua replica.

title: Sharding and partitioning
focus: Bedakan horizontal partitioning, shard key, hotspots, resharding, dan scatter-gather.
exercise: Pilih shard key untuk data transaksi marketplace.

title: Database migrations
focus: Pelajari backward-compatible schema changes, expand-contract, backfill, dan rollback.
exercise: Rancang perubahan kolom name menjadi first_name dan last_name tanpa downtime.

title: Caching fundamentals
focus: Pahami cache hit, miss, TTL, eviction, locality, dan stale data.
exercise: Tentukan data mana yang layak di-cache pada katalog film.

title: Cache-aside vs write-through
focus: Bandingkan alur read/write, consistency, failure mode, dan implementation cost.
exercise: Implementasikan pseudocode cache-aside untuk detail produk.

title: Cache invalidation
focus: Pelajari TTL, explicit invalidation, versioned key, event-driven invalidation, dan stampede.
exercise: Rancang invalidation ketika harga produk berubah.

title: Redis data structures
focus: Pahami string, hash, list, set, sorted set, stream, dan use case masing-masing.
exercise: Pilih struktur Redis untuk leaderboard, session, dan job queue.

title: CDN and HTTP caching
focus: Pahami Cache-Control, ETag, Last-Modified, private/public cache, dan revalidation.
exercise: Tentukan header caching untuk avatar, HTML dashboard, dan API response.

title: Process vs thread
focus: Bandingkan memory isolation, scheduling, communication cost, dan failure boundary.
exercise: Jelaskan pilihan worker process atau thread untuk web server.

title: Concurrency vs parallelism
focus: Bedakan interleaving task dengan eksekusi serentak pada banyak core.
exercise: Klasifikasikan web crawling dan image processing sebagai concurrency atau parallelism.

title: Race conditions
focus: Pahami shared state, non-atomic operation, critical section, dan synchronization.
exercise: Tulis contoh counter race lalu perbaiki dengan lock.

title: Deadlocks
focus: Pahami mutual exclusion, hold and wait, circular wait, ordering, dan timeout.
exercise: Analisis dua lock yang diambil dengan urutan berbeda.

title: Async and event loops
focus: Pahami non-blocking I/O, task, future, callback, backpressure, dan blocking trap.
exercise: Buat program async yang mengambil lima URL secara concurrent.

title: Memory stack vs heap
focus: Pahami lifetime, allocation, call frame, reference, garbage collection, dan leak.
exercise: Lacak lokasi konseptual variable lokal, object, dan closure.

title: Value vs reference semantics
focus: Bandingkan copy, aliasing, mutation, equality, dan function arguments.
exercise: Prediksi output beberapa contoh mutation pada array dan object.

title: Immutability
focus: Pahami predictable state, structural sharing, thread safety, dan allocation cost.
exercise: Refactor fungsi yang mengubah input menjadi fungsi immutable.

title: Pure functions and side effects
focus: Bedakan deterministic computation dengan I/O, mutation, clock, dan randomness.
exercise: Pisahkan business logic invoice dari akses database.

title: Error handling strategies
focus: Bandingkan exception, result type, error code, retry, fallback, dan fail-fast.
exercise: Desain error flow untuk pemesanan yang gagal saat pembayaran.

title: SOLID principles
focus: Pahami lima prinsip sebagai alat mengevaluasi perubahan, bukan aturan mekanis.
exercise: Temukan dua pelanggaran SOLID pada class service yang terlalu besar.

title: Composition vs inheritance
focus: Bandingkan reuse perilaku, coupling, substitutability, dan hierarchy fragility.
exercise: Refactor hierarchy notification menjadi composition berbasis channel.

title: Dependency injection
focus: Pahami inversion of control, constructor injection, testability, dan lifetime.
exercise: Inject repository palsu ke service agar dapat diuji tanpa database.

title: Repository and service patterns
focus: Pisahkan persistence concern dari business rules tanpa membuat abstraksi kosong.
exercise: Rancang boundary repository dan service untuk checkout.

title: Factory and strategy patterns
focus: Gunakan factory untuk creation dan strategy untuk perilaku yang dapat diganti.
exercise: Rancang beberapa metode perhitungan biaya pengiriman.

title: Observer and event-driven design
focus: Pahami publisher, subscriber, coupling, delivery semantics, dan event ordering.
exercise: Desain event OrderCreated dengan dua consumer.

title: State machines
focus: Modelkan state, transition, guard, invalid transition, dan terminal state.
exercise: Buat state machine untuk status pembayaran.

title: Unit vs integration vs end-to-end tests
focus: Bandingkan scope, speed, confidence, maintenance cost, dan failure diagnosis.
exercise: Susun test pyramid untuk fitur login.

title: Test doubles
focus: Bedakan dummy, stub, fake, spy, dan mock serta risiko over-mocking.
exercise: Pilih test double untuk payment gateway dan repository.

title: Testing boundaries and edge cases
focus: Pelajari equivalence partition, boundary values, empty input, overflow, dan time zones.
exercise: Tulis kasus uji untuk diskon berdasarkan rentang umur.

title: Property-based testing
focus: Pahami invariant, generated inputs, shrinking, dan kapan contoh manual tidak cukup.
exercise: Tentukan invariant untuk fungsi sort atau currency conversion.

title: Contract testing
focus: Validasi kesepakatan consumer-provider tanpa menjalankan seluruh sistem.
exercise: Rancang contract test antara checkout service dan payment service.

title: Load and stress testing
focus: Bedakan expected load, spike, endurance, breakpoint, latency percentile, dan throughput.
exercise: Tentukan skenario uji untuk ticket sale dengan traffic mendadak.

title: Authentication vs authorization
focus: Bedakan pembuktian identitas dengan keputusan akses serta prinsip least privilege.
exercise: Rancang akses admin, editor, dan viewer untuk dashboard.

title: Sessions vs JWT
focus: Bandingkan revocation, storage, scaling, token size, rotation, dan security risk.
exercise: Pilih session atau JWT untuk web app internal dan public API.

title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
focus: Pahami authorization code, PKCE, access token, refresh token, ID token, dan scopes.
exercise: Jelaskan login Google dari browser sampai aplikasi menerima identitas.

title: Password storage
focus: Pelajari salt, Argon2/bcrypt, work factor, pepper, breach response, dan reset flow.
exercise: Tulis checklist implementasi penyimpanan password.

title: SQL injection
focus: Pahami input-to-query flow, parameterized query, ORM pitfalls, dan least privilege.
exercise: Perbaiki query login yang dibangun melalui string concatenation.

title: XSS and output encoding
focus: Bedakan stored, reflected, DOM XSS, context-aware encoding, CSP, dan sanitization.
exercise: Cari sink berbahaya pada contoh penggunaan innerHTML.

title: CSRF
focus: Pahami ambient credentials, SameSite cookie, CSRF token, Origin check, dan unsafe methods.
exercise: Lindungi endpoint perubahan email berbasis cookie session.

title: CORS
focus: Pahami same-origin policy, preflight, allowed origins, credentials, dan common misconfiguration.
exercise: Konfigurasikan origin frontend tertentu tanpa wildcard.

title: Secrets management
focus: Pisahkan secret dari source code, gunakan rotation, scoped access, audit, dan environment injection.
exercise: Pindahkan API key hardcoded ke secret store atau CI secret.

title: Threat modeling
focus: Identifikasi asset, trust boundary, attacker, entry point, dan mitigasi dengan STRIDE.
exercise: Buat threat model singkat untuk file upload service.

title: Containers vs virtual machines
focus: Bandingkan kernel sharing, isolation, startup, image, portability, dan resource overhead.
exercise: Pilih container atau VM untuk tiga workload berbeda.

title: Docker images and layers
focus: Pahami Dockerfile, layer cache, build context, multi-stage build, dan image size.
exercise: Optimalkan Dockerfile aplikasi Node atau Python.

title: Docker networking
focus: Pelajari bridge network, port publishing, DNS antarkontainer, host, dan volume.
exercise: Hubungkan web app, API, dan database melalui Compose.

title: CI vs CD
focus: Bedakan continuous integration, delivery, deployment, quality gates, dan rollback.
exercise: Desain pipeline dari pull request sampai production.

title: Infrastructure as Code
focus: Pahami declarative state, plan, apply, drift, modules, dan state management.
exercise: Tulis struktur Terraform untuk satu web service.

title: Observability pillars
focus: Hubungkan logs, metrics, traces, context, correlation ID, dan actionable alerts.
exercise: Tentukan telemetry untuk endpoint checkout lambat.

title: SLI, SLO, and SLA
focus: Bedakan indikator, target internal, kontrak eksternal, error budget, dan trade-off reliability.
exercise: Buat SLO availability dan latency untuk sebuah API.

title: Blue-green vs canary deployment
focus: Bandingkan traffic switch, incremental exposure, rollback speed, dan infrastructure cost.
exercise: Pilih strategi deployment untuk perubahan payment service.

title: Horizontal vs vertical scaling
focus: Bandingkan scale up, scale out, limits, cost, load distribution, dan state.
exercise: Rancang scaling untuk API stateless dengan traffic naik sepuluh kali.

title: Serverless fundamentals
focus: Pahami function lifecycle, event triggers, cold start, limits, billing, dan lock-in.
exercise: Pilih serverless atau container untuk image thumbnail service.

title: Queues and background jobs
focus: Pahami producer, consumer, ack, retry, visibility timeout, DLQ, dan idempotency.
exercise: Desain proses pengiriman email setelah checkout.

title: Object storage vs block storage
focus: Bandingkan access model, durability, latency, filesystem, dan use case.
exercise: Pilih storage untuk database disk, video, backup, dan user upload.

title: High availability
focus: Pahami redundancy, failure domain, multi-zone, health checks, failover, dan RTO/RPO.
exercise: Rancang layanan tetap hidup ketika satu availability zone gagal.

title: CAP theorem
focus: Pahami consistency, availability, partition tolerance, serta batas interpretasi CAP.
exercise: Analisis pilihan saat network partition pada inventory service.

title: Consistency models
focus: Bandingkan strong, eventual, read-your-writes, monotonic reads, dan causal consistency.
exercise: Pilih model untuk saldo bank, likes, dan product search.

title: At-least-once delivery
focus: Pahami duplicate message, lost acknowledgment, retry, deduplication, dan idempotent consumer.
exercise: Buat consumer pembayaran aman terhadap pesan ganda.

title: Distributed locks
focus: Pelajari lease, fencing token, clock issue, failure mode, dan kapan lock harus dihindari.
exercise: Evaluasi lock untuk scheduled job yang berjalan pada banyak instance.

title: Saga transactions
focus: Bandingkan choreography, orchestration, compensating action, dan partial failure.
exercise: Rancang saga order, payment, dan inventory.

title: Event sourcing and CQRS
focus: Pahami event log, projections, replay, command/query separation, dan complexity cost.
exercise: Modelkan perubahan saldo sebagai event.

title: Design a URL shortener
focus: Gabungkan ID generation, redirect, database, caching, analytics, dan abuse control.
exercise: Buat estimasi traffic serta sketsa komponen utama.

title: Design a notification system
focus: Pahami preference, template, queue, provider, retry, deduplication, dan delivery status.
exercise: Desain email, SMS, dan push notification dari satu event.

title: Design a chat service
focus: Bahas connection management, message ordering, presence, storage, fan-out, dan offline delivery.
exercise: Rancang flow pengiriman pesan satu-ke-satu.

title: Design a rate limiter
focus: Tentukan algorithm, key, distributed state, atomic update, headers, dan failure behavior.
exercise: Desain limiter per-user serta per-IP.

title: Design a file upload service
focus: Bahas direct upload, signed URL, multipart, validation, scanning, metadata, dan CDN.
exercise: Rancang upload video besar yang dapat dilanjutkan setelah putus.

title: Design a search system
focus: Pahami indexing pipeline, inverted index, ranking, typo tolerance, freshness, dan pagination.
exercise: Rancang pencarian produk berdasarkan nama dan kategori.

title: Design an audit log
focus: Bahas append-only data, actor, action, timestamp, integrity, retention, dan querying.
exercise: Tentukan schema audit untuk perubahan role pengguna.

title: Big O complexity
focus: Analisis growth rate, worst/average case, time-space trade-off, dan hidden constants.
exercise: Hitung kompleksitas tiga loop dan satu recursive function.

title: Arrays vs linked lists
focus: Bandingkan contiguous memory, random access, insertion, cache locality, dan overhead.
exercise: Pilih struktur untuk queue, indexed lookup, dan frequent middle insertion.

title: Hash tables
focus: Pahami hash function, collision, load factor, resizing, dan expected O(1).
exercise: Implementasikan map sederhana dengan separate chaining.

title: Stacks and queues
focus: Pahami LIFO, FIFO, deque, serta aplikasi pada parsing, traversal, dan scheduling.
exercise: Gunakan stack untuk validasi bracket dan queue untuk BFS.

title: Trees and graph traversal
focus: Bandingkan tree, graph, DFS, BFS, visited set, dan shortest unweighted path.
exercise: Implementasikan BFS untuk mencari jarak minimum.

title: Binary search
focus: Pahami invariant, sorted requirement, boundary bugs, lower bound, dan O(log n).
exercise: Implementasikan pencarian elemen pertama yang memenuhi kondisi.

title: Recursion and dynamic programming
focus: Bedakan overlapping subproblem, memoization, tabulation, state, dan transition.
exercise: Ubah Fibonacci recursive menjadi memoized dan bottom-up.

title: Monolith vs microservices
focus: Bandingkan deployment, coupling, data ownership, team boundaries, observability, dan operational cost.
exercise: Pilih arsitektur untuk startup baru dengan tim lima engineer.

title: Modular monolith
focus: Pahami module boundary, internal API, dependency direction, dan jalur evolusi.
exercise: Bagi aplikasi commerce menjadi modul tanpa memisah deployment.

title: Event-driven architecture
focus: Pelajari event, command, broker, schema evolution, replay, dan eventual consistency.
exercise: Desain event flow setelah order berhasil dibuat.

title: API gateway and backend for frontend
focus: Bandingkan centralized cross-cutting concerns dengan API khusus tiap client.
exercise: Rancang API untuk web dan mobile yang membutuhkan bentuk data berbeda.

title: Git merge vs rebase
focus: Pahami commit graph, history rewriting, conflict resolution, dan collaboration safety.
exercise: Simulasikan merge dan rebase pada dua branch kecil.

title: Code review that finds risk
focus: Fokus pada correctness, security, maintainability, tests, dan context. Hindari komentar kosmetik berlebihan.
exercise: Review sebuah diff dan tulis tiga komentar yang actionable.

title: Feature flags
focus: Pahami decoupled release, targeting, kill switch, cleanup, dan testing combinations.
exercise: Rancang rollout fitur baru untuk 5%, 25%, lalu 100% user.

title: Technical debt
focus: Bedakan deliberate debt, accidental complexity, interest, prioritization, dan measurable impact.
exercise: Pilih satu debt dan tulis alasan bisnis untuk memperbaikinya.

title: Writing an ADR
focus: Dokumentasikan context, decision, alternatives, consequences, dan status.
exercise: Tulis ADR pemilihan PostgreSQL dibanding MongoDB.

title: Debugging systematically
focus: Gunakan reproduction, hypothesis, evidence, isolation, instrumentation, dan regression test.
exercise: Debug contoh bug dengan membuat daftar hipotesis sebelum mengubah kode.
